learningGoals: Identify different animals and their habitats, such as monkeys in trees and crocodiles in water. 🌴
Understand the concepts of friendship, trust, and cleverness. 🤝
Read dialogues with different voices for different characters. 🗣️
Learn to use describing words (adjectives) like 'smart', 'big', and 'sweet'. ✨
Express empathy and discuss how characters feel at different points in the story. ❤️
conversationStarters: If you could swing from tree to tree like a monkey, where would you go? 🌴
Do you think it is important to be quick-thinking when you are in trouble? 💭
What kind of sweet fruits do you think the monkey was eating? 🍉
teachingTips: Assign roles (you be the crocodile, child is the monkey) and read the dialogues with dramatic voices. 🎭
Discuss the difference between land animals and water animals. 🐢
Use this story to talk about who we should trust and how to handle tricky situations safely. 🛡️
Point out action words (verbs) like 'jump', 'swim', and 'eat' in the text. 🏃‍♀️
Ask open-ended questions like 'What would happen if the monkey didn't think of a plan?' ❓

funActivities.title: Animal Charades 🐒🐊
funActivities.description: Take turns acting out different animals from the jungle without making a sound. The other person has to guess the animal in English.

funActivities.title: Build a Monkey Treehouse 🛖
funActivities.description: Use pillows, blankets, or building blocks to create a safe 'tree' for a toy monkey. Talk about how monkeys stay safe up high.

funActivities.title: Fruit Tasting Adventure 🍓
funActivities.description: Cut up different sweet fruits (like bananas, apples, or berries). Have a tasting session and ask your child to describe the taste using English words.
